answer: Each agent locks 1,200 POA yield-free for six epochs in an umber reserve that earns nothing. At a published minute each epoch, a public beacon throws a 32-byte ember; the agent has 45 seconds to sign (address, prompt, epoch) and collect a one-time jade receipt bound to that address alone. A missed window, a copied signature, or two keys sharing one signer, moves 300 POA from the reserve and benches the identity for three epochs. One honest seat is 1,200 POA at rest; a thousand sockpuppets need a thousand independent on-time signers and 1.2 million locked, which a rented botnet cannot staff.
